molecules.name: BDNF (Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor)
molecules.label_th: BDNF สารปลูกสมอง
molecules.role: Promotes neurogenesis (dentate gyrus), LTP, synaptic plasticity; elevated by exercise

molecules.name: Acetylcholine (ACh)
molecules.label_th: อะเซทิลโคลีน
molecules.role: Memory encoding, attention, muscle control; depleted in Alzheimer basal forebrain

molecules.name: Dopamine
molecules.role: Reward anticipation, motivation, working memory (prefrontal cortex)

molecules.name: DHA (Docosahexaenoic Acid)
molecules.role: Structural component of synaptosomal membranes (30-40%); anti-inflammatory; neuroprotectin D1 precursor

molecules.name: EPA (Eicosapentaenoic Acid)
molecules.role: Anti-inflammatory via competitive inhibition of AA eicosanoids; antidepressant effects

molecules.name: Beta-Hydroxybutyrate (BHB)
molecules.role: Alternative neuronal fuel; NLRP3 inhibitor; HDAC inhibitor; neuroprotective

molecules.name: NGF (Nerve Growth Factor)
molecules.label_th: NGF ปัจจัยเติบโตประสาท
molecules.role: Supports cholinergic neuron survival and neurite outgrowth; stimulated by Lion's Mane

molecules.name: Phosphatidylserine (PS)
molecules.label_th: ฟอสฟาไทดิลเซอรีน
molecules.role: Neuronal membrane cytosolic leaflet; neurotransmitter vesicle exocytosis; cortisol modulation

molecules.name: Alpha-GPC (Alpha-glycerophosphocholine)
molecules.role: Highly bioavailable choline donor; crosses BBB; acetylcholine precursor; GH releasing

molecules.name: Bacopa monnieri (Bacosides A+B)
molecules.role: Dendritic branching in hippocampus CA3; AChE inhibition; GABAergic anxiety reduction

molecules.name: Hericium erinaceus (Lion's Mane)
molecules.label_th: เห็ดสิงโต / Lion's Mane
molecules.role: Hericenones + erinacines stimulate NGF; neurite outgrowth; possible MCI benefit

molecules.name: L-Tyrosine
molecules.label_th: แอล-ไทโรซีน
molecules.role: Precursor of dopamine and noradrenaline; replenishes catecholamines under acute stress

molecules.name: Rhodiola rosea
molecules.label_th: โรดิโอล่า โรเซีย
molecules.role: MAO-A/B inhibition; serotonin + dopamine elevation; cortisol reduction; cognitive stress performance

molecules.name: Anthocyanins (blueberry/berry polyphenols)
molecules.label_th: แอนโทไซยานิน จากบลูเบอรี่
molecules.role: Cerebral blood flow; BDNF; anti-inflammatory; processing speed improvement
